'''Imperial Works Project 900316A''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] project that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Guyvar]] was involved with on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I'm Captain Guyvar. Nonzo here leads the workers. And all around you is Imperial Works Project 900316A&mdash;ecological studies crew. My boys shoot up the local wildlife&mdash;anything with claws, pretty much&mdash;while the workers take plant samples and try not to get killed.|Guyvar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Imperial Works Project 900316A was originally detailed in a cut mission in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which identified the project as an ecological studies crew manned by [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] workers. The mission was cut from the game before release, but Guyvar still mentions the name of the project when clicked on.
